# Oak Grove Memorial Gardens, Inc.

Oak Grove Memorial Gardens, Inc. is a nonprofit organization. Oak Grove Memorial Gardens is a company that provides funeral services and memorial gardens. They offer merchandise, resources, and wreaths across America. They also have memorial gardens for celebrating life. Oak Grove Memorial Gardens, Inc. employs 3 people. Headquartered in Irving, Texas, United States.

## About

Irving's only perpetual care cemetery. Serving Irving and the surrounding communities since 1933.

# Tour Our Grounds
### We'll be pleased to welcome your visit to our warm and comfortable offices. Oak Grove Memorial Gardens was designed to be unlike any cemetery you've ever seen; it's truly a one-of-a-kind place.
We invite you to come in and see for yourself how we're revolutionizing the way you think about cemeteries and funeral service. We'll be pleased to welcome you into our inviting offices, and act as your escort as you tour the diverse landscape and memorial properties.
